title: LISA
sub: LISA recorded a note straight to LILIES and it sat on the channel for any host to play into a live show. Eight seconds of artist time, in front of 162,165 people.
context: LISA's note to LILIES, a channel of 162,165, added hours before the SaWaDiKa party.
claim:
Eight seconds of her voice.
162,165 members.
